_purpose: THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the eight page-2 life-area predictions of the Birth Jathagam. Page 2 of the report and the AI Astrologer chat both compute from this file. Neither keeps a private copy of the logic.
_whyHere: This repo already shares JSON between the TypeScript builders and the PHP engine - see api/astrology/rajju.json, read by src/lib/astrology/matchmaking.ts and babynames.ts. This file follows the same pattern so PHP 8.0 can json_decode it without a Node build step.
_extractedFrom: The constants and the verdict rule below were read out of src/services/jathagamHtmlBuilder.ts buildJathagamLifeCards (lines 122, 192-193, 256-262) and its PHP mirror api/astrology/pdf_mpdf_reports.php $lifeCardsData (line 1489). They are recorded here verbatim so the extraction can be checked against the code, not trusted.

constants._dignityOffset: An exalted or own-sign lord offsets exactly ONE malefic conjunction (jathagamHtmlBuilder.ts line 257).
constants._debilitatedMalefic: A debilitated malefic is in its weakest state and is NOT counted as a strong malefic (line 243).
constants._nodesHaveNoDebilitation: Rahu and Ketu have no debilitation sign: the classical schools disagree, so dignity.ts reports 'not-applicable'. Never invent one.

verdict._precedence: isChallenging wins. A card is Caution if ANY challenge flag is set, even if it is also supportive. This is the conclusion the chat must not contradict.

statusWords._purpose: The short verdict word the templates interpolate as {status}. Both the report and the chat must use these exact words so the wording matches.

consistencyContract.rule: Page 2 of the Birth Jathagam and the AI Astrologer chat MUST produce the same verdict for the same chart, in all three languages.
consistencyContract.enforcedBy: tests/ai-astrologer-consistency.test.ts, which runs five sample charts through the shared module and compares the report verdict against the chat verdict for all 8 areas in 3 languages (120 comparisons). Any mismatch fails the suite.
chatBehaviour: For any of the 8 life areas, start from the stored report prediction and keep the same conclusion, tone and periods.
The chat may ADD detail - Dasha/Bhukti timing, transits, remedies - but must NOT change or contradict the stored conclusion.
For anything the report does not cover, answer from the chart using the same rules, consistent with the report.
If chart data and the stored report ever disagree: do not argue with the customer, log it for admin review, reply with the report's version, and offer 'Talk to our astrologer'.

_sourcePolicy: Each card's `sources` are the same references the chat's retrieval rules already cite for that area, taken from knowledge/ai-astrologer/rules/life-areas.json by cardIndex. Nothing here was invented: every id must exist in sources.json with a citable verification status. tests/ai-astrologer-consistency.test.ts enforces it, including the level rules - 'passage' only where verifiedPassages exist (TA-02, TA-07), 'chapter' only for EN-02, and never a linked-not-opened, dead or excluded source. Because page 2 and the chat both read this file, they cite the same authorities at the same level.
